work_item.title: Paired randomized replicated Arena experiment runner
work_item.notes: The harness-independent control plane is reachable from main through PR #40 (5573a6a7b267676e2cf77e8e1d0959a74067ece2): signed deterministic preregistration, paired/randomized invocation identity, fresh one-attempt workspaces, complete failure denominators, content-addressed signed bundles, and credential-free offline replay. Completion remains open because no pinned BenchFlow baseline/candidate matrix and raw runtime evidence have landed yet.
